resources.string: Tracker needs location access to record your route and show it on the map. Location data stays on this device — nothing is sent to a server.

Tracker uses activity recognition to detect what you\'re doing (walking, cycling, driving, still) so auto-tracking can pause when you\'re not moving and save battery. Activity data stays on this device — nothing is sent to a server.

To keep recording your route when you switch apps or the screen turns off, Tracker needs to access your location in the background. The recorded location stays on this device — nothing is sent to a server. On the next system prompt please pick "Allow all the time"; "While using the app" keeps Tracker working when its screen is open only.
Location permission required to start tracking
